dei.evidence: Our workforce is globally diverse to create an inclusive, high-performance culture that is agile, entrepreneurial and accountable.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, patient-first framing with patients placed at the centre of everything. Written in first-person plural. Commitments are often hedged (strive, aspire, dedicated to) but some are absolute (we conduct business with the utmost integrity). Innovation and integrity recur, and the page lists shared values and short thematic sections for ethics, inclusion, sustainability and responsibility.
